verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַֽ֭לְלוּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū yāh hal·lū ’eṯ- šêm Yah·weh hal·lū ‘aḇ·ḏê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . Praise the name of the LORD Give praise O servants of the LORD

verses.original: שֶׁ֣֭עֹֽמְדִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝חַצְר֗וֹת בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: še·ʿō·mə·d̲îm bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh bə·ḥaṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: who stand in the house of the LORD in the courts of the house of our God

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּ־ יָהּ כִּי־ ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה זַמְּר֥וּ לִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹ כִּ֣י נָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū- yāh kî- ṭō·wḇ Yah·weh zam·mə·rū liš·mōw kî nā·‘îm
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . for the LORD is good sing praises to His name for it is lovely

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּחַ֣ר ל֣וֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִסְגֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ya·‘ă·qōḇ bā·ḥar lōw yāh yiś·rā·’êl lis·ḡul·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own Israel as His treasured possession

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּי־ גָד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מִכָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- ḡā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh wa·’ă·ḏō·nê·nū mik·kāl ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For I know that the LORD is great our Lord is above all gods

verses.original: כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ חָפֵ֥ץ יְהוָ֗ה עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֝יַּמִּ֗ים וְכָל־ תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kōl ’ă·šer- ḥā·p̄êṣ Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh baš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḇā·’ā·reṣ bay·yam·mîm wə·ḵāl tə·hō·w·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth in the seas and in all their depths

verses.original: מַֽעֲלֶ֣ה נְשִׂאִים֮ מִקְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ בְּרָקִ֣ים לַמָּטָ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה מֽוֹצֵא־ ר֝וּחַ מֵאֽוֹצְרוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ma·‘ă·leh nə·śi·’îm miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ bə·rā·qîm lam·mā·ṭār ‘ā·śāh mō·w·ṣê- rū·aḥ mê·’ō·wṣ·rō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses

verses.original: שֶֽׁ֭הִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם מֵ֝אָדָ֗ם עַד־ בְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Še·hik·kāh bə·ḵō·w·rê miṣ·rā·yim mê·’ā·ḏām ‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt of both man and beast

verses.original: שָׁלַ֤ח׀ אֹת֣וֹת וּ֭מֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵ֣כִי מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּ֝פַרְעֹ֗ה וּבְכָל־ עֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šā·laḥ ’ō·ṯō·wṯ ū·mō·p̄ə·ṯîm bə·ṯō·w·ḵê·ḵî miṣ·rā·yim bə·p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw
verses.literal: He sent signs and wonders into your midst O Egypt against Pharaoh and all his servants

verses.original: שֶֽׁ֭הִכָּה גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝הָרַ֗ג מְלָכִ֥ים עֲצוּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Še·hik·kāh gō·w·yim rab·bîm wə·hā·raḡ mə·lā·ḵîm ‘ă·ṣū·mîm
verses.literal: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings

verses.original: לְסִיח֤וֹן׀ מֶ֤לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֗י וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן וּ֝לְכֹ֗ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ū·lə·‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ hab·bā·šān ū·lə·ḵōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: Sihon king of the Amorites Og king of Bashan and all the kings of Canaan

verses.original: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם נַחֲלָ֑ה נַ֝חֲלָ֗ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan ’ar·ṣām na·ḥă·lāh na·ḥă·lāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: He gave their land as an inheritance as a heritage to His people Israel

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה זִכְרְךָ֥ לְדֹר־ וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh šim·ḵā lə·‘ō·w·lām Yah·weh ziḵ·rə·ḵā lə·ḏōr- wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: Your name O LORD endures forever Your renown O LORD through all generations . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יָדִ֣ין יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְעַל־ עֲ֝בָדָ֗יו יִתְנֶחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·ḏîn Yah·weh ‘am·mōw wə·‘al- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw yiṯ·ne·ḥām
verses.literal: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants

verses.original: עֲצַבֵּ֣י הַ֭גּוֹיִם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṣab·bê hag·gō·w·yim ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: The idols of the nations are silver and gold made by the hands of men

verses.original: פֶּֽה־ לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: peh- lā·hem wə·lō yə·ḏab·bê·rū ‘ê·na·yim lā·hem wə·lō yir·’ū
verses.literal: They have mouths . . . but cannot speak they have eyes . . . but cannot see

verses.original: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ אַ֝֗ף אֵין־ יֶשׁ־ ר֥וּחַ בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·zə·na·yim lā·hem wə·lō ya·’ă·zî·nū ’ap̄ ’ên- yeš- rū·aḥ bə·p̄î·hem
verses.literal: they have ears . . . but cannot hear nor is there breath in their mouths

verses.original: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר־ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mō·w·hem yih·yū ‘ō·śê·hem kōl ’ă·šer- bō·ṭê·aḥ bā·hem
verses.literal: Those who make them become like them as do all who trust in them

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֥ית אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl bā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- Yah·weh bêṯ ’a·hă·rōn bā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: O house of Israel bless the LORD O house of Aaron bless the LORD

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית הַ֭לֵּוִי בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה יִֽרְאֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ hal·lê·wî bā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- Yah·weh yir·’ê Yah·weh bā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: O house of Levi bless the LORD you who fear the LORD bless the LORD

verses.original: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה׀ מִצִּיּ֗וֹן שֹׁ֘כֵ֤ן יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn šō·ḵên yə·rū·šā·lim hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD from Zion He who dwells in Jerusalem Hallelujah . . .
